_help: Node + pnpm preset. Gates run in the repo root; every required gate must exit 0 before a slice can be verified. Adjust the script names to this repo's package.json. Air-gapped: point .npmrc at your internal registry and, once the store is populated, run with --offline / --prefer-offline.
session_budget_hint: A slice should fit one agent session: ~1 vertical behavior, < ~10 files touched, tests included. If it won't fit in your head, split it.
